newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly down on foreign selling.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly down on foreign selling.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended down slightly on Thursday at 8.3013 against the U.S. dollar from Wednesday's 8.3009 on selling mainly by foreign-invested enterprises, traders said.
The yuan opened little changed at 8.3010 and consolidated in a range between an intra-day high of 8.3009 and a low of 8.3016. Trading was active, with most done at 8.3012, traders said.
"Some foreign-invested enterprises were seen selling the yuan for dollars which they will remit outside China for annual settlement," one dealer said.
"But most Chinese firms wanted to hold yuan, which supported the local currency above 8.3020 today," a second dealer said.
Dealers said that active buying and selling forced the yuan to move in a narrow range today and they expect the trend to continue on Friday.
The yuan closed down at an intra-day low of 7.3700 from 7.3500 against 100 Japanese yen and little changed at 1.0743 from 1.0742 against the Hong Kong dollar.
